$comment: CONFIRMED authentication header: Authorization: Bearer <OPENANY_API_KEY>. The header is optional. Browsing, search, and pricing work without a key; only run_api needs it. Merge mcp.servers into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. IMPORTANT: transport must be streamable-http; omitting it defaults to sse, which this endpoint does not use. CLI alternative (also configure the optional env-backed header below when executing): openclaw mcp add openany --url https://mcp.openany.si --transport streamable-http
